Athletes invest a huge amount of time and energy in their training in order to prepare for their competitions in the best possible way. The Olympic Games are the absolute pinnacle of any sporting career. Every athlete trains with the aim of being at the peak of their performance and giving their best at precisely this most important moment. Who has trained best and who can withstand the pressure will ultimately decide who is successful.
